caption:
How many shop trips this week? Comment the number.

It's easy to forget something on a list written from memory; in WE.LIFE you build a meal plan and the shopping list comes from the recipes, with quantities, minus what's in your pantry. One bigger shop instead of several trips for a single item.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#groceryshopping #mealplan #mealprep
